name: Kling 3.0 (Motion Control)
description: Kling 3.0 motion control: drive a character image with a reference video. Billed per output second.

image_url.description: URL of the character image to animate: jpg/png, at least 300px on each side, aspect between 1:2.5 and 2.5:1.
image_url.title: Image Url

video_url.description: URL of the reference video that drives the motion.
video_url.title: Video Url

character_orientation.description: Whether the character faces the orientation from the image or the reference video.
character_orientation.title: Character Orientation

audio.description: Whether to keep the reference video's original audio.
audio.title: Audio
